workflows.title: Career
workflows.description: A closed-loop job search from market research through interview feedback.

stages.title: Career baseline
stages.purpose: Lock the target, evidence, constraints, and success measure.

stages.title: Market scan
stages.purpose: Find current, credible roles and employer signals.

stages.title: Ranked shortlist
stages.purpose: Score opportunities against fit, constraints, and upside.

stages.title: Application kit
stages.purpose: Tailor the resume, cover note, and evidence for one selected role.

stages.title: Application review
stages.purpose: Preview and submit the selected application in the user's browser.

stages.title: Application tracking
stages.purpose: Record state, dates, follow-ups, and missing evidence.

stages.title: Interview preparation
stages.purpose: Build a paced interview loop grounded in the role and company.

stages.title: Outcome review
stages.purpose: Use outcomes to update targeting, application evidence, and preparation.

workflows.title: Health
workflows.description: Personal-context food, movement, and adherence planning with safety boundaries.

intake.label: Primary goal
intake.placeholder: Improve energy and lose weight gradually

intake.label: Current baseline
intake.placeholder: Typical meals, sleep, movement, work pattern

stages.title: Baseline and goal
stages.purpose: Capture current routines, limits, preferences, and the intended outcome.

stages.title: Safety boundary
stages.purpose: Identify red flags, clinician constraints, and what Narad must not infer.

stages.title: Weekly food and movement plan
stages.purpose: Create a realistic seven-day plan with substitutions and recovery room.

stages.title: Schedule preview
stages.purpose: Preview calendar blocks and check-ins before creating them.

stages.title: Daily tracking
stages.purpose: Collect lightweight adherence, energy, sleep, and discomfort signals.

stages.title: Weekly adaptation
stages.purpose: Compare plan with lived reality and make the smallest useful adjustment.

workflows.title: Travel
workflows.description: Constraint-aware discovery, itinerary design, and confirmation-gated booking help.

intake.label: Trip style
intake.placeholder: Food, design, slower pace, no nightlife

stages.title: Travel brief
stages.purpose: Lock dates, people, budget, pace, and hard constraints.

stages.title: Live destination research
stages.purpose: Ground options in current transport, seasonality, closures, and local evidence.

stages.title: Option comparison
stages.purpose: Compare routes and stays using consistent criteria and total cost.

stages.title: Itinerary and budget
stages.purpose: Produce a coherent day-by-day plan with budget and alternatives.

stages.title: Booking desk
stages.purpose: Recheck availability and preview each reservation before commitment.

stages.title: Trip-ready pack
stages.purpose: Prepare confirmations, checklist, maps, and critical reminders.

stages.title: Change review
stages.purpose: Re-plan only the portions affected by a price, weather, or availability change.

workflows.title: Teach Anything
workflows.eyebrow: One concept, one check, durable mastery
workflows.description: A paced learning path backed by Gurukul workspaces and spaced review.

intake.label: Learning outcome
intake.placeholder: Explain it confidently in an interview

stages.title: Learning mission
stages.purpose: Define the outcome, starting point, pace, and evidence of mastery.

stages.title: Diagnostic
stages.purpose: Ask the smallest useful question to locate the learner's current model.

stages.title: Paced lesson
stages.purpose: Teach one frontier concept with an analogy and one concrete example.

stages.title: Understanding check
stages.purpose: Use one question to test transfer rather than recognition.

stages.title: Targeted reinforcement
stages.purpose: Correct the named misconception with a different representation.

stages.title: Mastery review
stages.purpose: Record mastery, schedule the next review, and choose the next atom.

workflows.title: Personal Finance
workflows.eyebrow: See clearly, model choices, stay in control
workflows.description: Local ledger intelligence, grounded scenarios, and recurring financial reviews.

intake.label: Monthly cash-flow context
intake.placeholder: Approximate income, fixed costs, variable costs

stages.title: Financial baseline
stages.purpose: Define goals, cash-flow assumptions, obligations, and risk boundaries.

stages.title: Local data intake
stages.purpose: Import or update transactions and balances without exposing credentials.

stages.title: Cash-flow intelligence
stages.purpose: Measure spending, recurring costs, anomalies, and goal trajectory.

stages.title: Current intelligence and scenarios
stages.purpose: Ground rates, rules, and market assumptions in dated sources.

stages.title: Decision plan
stages.purpose: Compare choices, tradeoffs, buffers, and reversible next steps.

stages.title: Monthly review
stages.purpose: Compare plan with actuals and adapt budgets or goal timing.

workflows.title: Documents and Insights
workflows.eyebrow: Evidence into a story people can use
workflows.description: Analyze source material and produce presentations, insight reports, or polished narratives.

intake.label: Objective
intake.placeholder: What should the audience understand or decide?

stages.title: Creative brief
stages.purpose: Lock the audience, decision, source material, format, and constraints.

stages.title: Source ingestion
stages.purpose: Extract files and establish an exact evidence inventory.

stages.title: Analysis and insights
stages.purpose: Read structured sources and find defensible patterns, caveats, and decision-relevant insights.

stages.title: Narrative architecture
stages.purpose: Turn evidence into one coherent argument or creative arc.

stages.title: Artifact production
stages.purpose: Create the requested deck, report, chart set, or narrative.

stages.title: Design and truth audit
stages.purpose: Audit clarity, evidence, pacing, visual hierarchy, and unsupported claims.

stages.title: Final export
stages.purpose: Version and expose the final artifact with source and provenance links.
